faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Silchar Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NIT Silchar Project Associate-I recruitment is 21 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate-I post at NIT Silchar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's or Master's degree in specified fields like Chemistry, Polymer Sciences, Materials Science, Nanoscience, Mechanical Engineering, etc.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-I position is 50 years, with relaxation as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is between Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 37,000 per month, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the NIT Silchar Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-I position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is NIT Silchar located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Silchar is located in Silchar, Assam, with the pincode 788010.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is NITS/Dean(R&C)/ME/722/01/2026.
